context: Checks whether the final artifact follows the code-review instructions from the published Rails Agent Skills tile.

checklist.name: instruction-1
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Self-review the actual full branch diff using the Review Order below.

checklist.name: instruction-2
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Core principle:** Review early, review often. Self-review before PR. Re-review after significant changes.

checklist.name: instruction-3
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Use **only** these labels:

checklist.name: instruction-4
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **`Critical`** — security, data loss, crash, or **Always Critical** (see below). Block merge.

checklist.name: instruction-5
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Always Critical (flag every occurrence):**

checklist.name: instruction-6
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Review principle** — State: "Review early, review often. Self-review before PR. Re-review after significant changes."

checklist.name: instruction-7
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: Findings must come from an actual diff or provided file contents. Do not present a simulated PR review as if it were a completed review of real code.

checklist.name: instruction-8
checklist.description: The submitted artifact follows this skill instruction: **Task-list handoff** — Always include a `Code review before merge` task or task-list line.
